FULL TEXT:
1
GOVERNMENT OF TELANGANA
OFFICE OF THE COLLECTOR AND DISTRICT MAGISTRATE, JANGAON
(Chairperson, District Hub for Empowerment of Women)
Notification No.06/DHEW/2026 Dated: 08.10.2026
Sub: Mission Shakti – District Hub for Empowerment of Women, Jangaon – Engagement
of personnel in all six posts on contract basis – Written examination on Thursday, the
15th October 2026 – Notification issued.
Ref: 1. Mission Shakti Scheme Implementation Guidelines of the Ministry of Women and
Child Development, Government of India, para 3.1 and Annexure IV.
2. D.O.Lr.No.3541/TS/SHEW/2022, dated 10.03.2023 of the Commissioner, Women
Development and Child Welfare, Hyderabad.
3. Proceedings Rc.No.COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026, dated 08.10.2026 of the
Collector, Jangaon, on the posts of the District Hub for Empowerment of Women.
* * *
1. The District Hub for Empowerment of Women, Jangaon, works under the Samarthya
component of Mission Shakti. All six posts of the Hub are to be filled afresh by open
selection, as ordered in the reference third cited. Applications are invited from eligible
candidates for engagement, on contract basis, in the posts shown below.
Sl.No. Post Number Who may apply
Consolidated
remuneration per
month
1 District Mission Coordinator 1 Men and women Rs.38,500
2 Gender Specialist 2 Men and women Rs.25,000
3 Specialist in Financial Literacy 1 Men and women Rs.22,750
4 Accounts Assistant 1 Men and women Rs.20,000
5 Multi Tasking Staff 1 Men and women Rs.15,600
2. The qualification and experience for each post are those laid down in Annexure IV of the
guidelines first cited. Under the guidelines they shall not be lowered under any
circumstances. A higher qualification in the same subject is accepted in place of the
degree prescribed. The qualification and experience shall be held on the date of this
notification.

3. A candidate shall have completed 21 years and shall not have completed 44 years of age
on 01.10.2026. The guidelines first cited prescribe no age limit, and the upper age limit
of 44 years now in force for direct recruitment to posts under the State, other than
uniformed services, is adopted. It is relaxed by five years for candidates of the Scheduled
Castes, Scheduled Tribes and Backward Classes, and by ten years for persons with
benchmark disabilities. It does not apply to persons now working in the Hub.
4. Experience will be counted only where the certificate shows the post held and the dates
of joining and relieving, and is supported by the appointment order and proof of payment
such as bank statement, pay slips or EPF record. Field work, project work or internship
done as a student, and voluntary service, will not be counted. A certificate issued by a
non-Government organisation shall carry the registration number of the organisation and,
where it has one, its NGO Darpan identity number. Every certificate relied upon will be
referred to the issuing authority for confirmation.
5. Selection will be by a written examination followed, on the same day, by an oral test of
25 marks. The selection list will be declared the same day.
(a) For the posts at Sl.No.1 to 4 the written examination carries 200 objective questions
for 90 minutes, in English. Part A of 100 questions is common to these posts. Part
B of 100 questions is on the work of the post applied for.
(b) For the post at Sl.No.5 the written examination carries 100 objective questions for
60 minutes, in English and Telugu.
(c) In every paper each question has five options and carries one mark. One fourth of
a mark will be deducted for every wrong answer. Nothing is deducted for a question
left unanswered. Answers are marked on an OMR answer sheet. The syllabus is in
Annexure II.
(d) For the posts of Gender Specialist and Specialist in Financial Literacy, for which
the guidelines prefer post-graduates, five marks will be added for a post graduate
degree in a subject relevant to the post.
(e) The key will be displayed at the venue at 12.00 noon on the day of the examination.
Objections to the key, in writing and with proof, will be received at the venue up
to 12.45 PM and decided before the result is declared.
(f) The result of the written examination will be displayed at the venue at 2.00 PM.
Candidates will be called the same day for verification of original certificates and
COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026-ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER O/O DCO I/6485/2026
3
the oral test, in the order of marks, at three candidates for each vacancy. Every
candidate shall therefore bring all original certificates to the venue and remain there
till the result is displayed. A candidate who is absent when called, does not produce
the originals, or is found not eligible, will be passed over and the next candidate
called. No other date will be given.
(g) In the oral test each candidate will answer five questions drawn from a question
bank. Each answer will be marked out of five by the Selection Committee on a
scoring sheet, which forms part of the record.
(h) The selection list for each post will be drawn in the order of the total marks. Where
the total is equal, the candidate with more marks in the written examination, and
then the candidate older in age, will be placed higher. The list will be declared the
same evening. Orders of appointment will issue on the next day, the 16.10.2026, to
every candidate on whom the report of the Police and the certificate of medical
fitness are received. The appointment is subject to confirmation of the certificates
by the issuing authorities; where a certificate is not confirmed the contract ends
without notice. A waiting list will be kept for one year.

7. Applications in the form in Annexure I, with self attested copies of the certificates listed
in it and two passport size photographs, shall be handed over at the Inward Section of the
Collectorate, Integrated District Offices Complex, Jangaon, from 09.10.2026 to
14.10.2026, between 10.30 AM and 5.00 PM on working days and between 10.30 AM
and 1.00 PM on Saturday, the 10.10.2026. The hall ticket will be issued across the counter
on receipt of the application. Applications sent by registered post or speed post shall
reach the Collectorate by 5.00 PM on 14.10.2026, and the cover shall be superscribed
with the name of the post. Applications will not be received at the office of the District
COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026-ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER O/O DCO I/6485/2026
4
Welfare Officer or in the Hub. A candidate may apply for one post only. The written
examinations under Notifications No.04/CHL/2026, No.05/CH/2026 and
No.06/DHEW/2026 are held at the same hour on the same day, and a candidate may
apply under only one of them. There is no application fee.
8. Admission to the written examination is provisional. The venue will be announced on
the district website https://jangaon.telangana.gov.in and on the notice board of the
Collectorate by 13.10.2026. Candidates who applied by post shall collect the hall ticket
at the help desk at the venue between 8.30 AM and 9.15 AM on the day of the
examination, on production of an identity card. The candidate shall bring the hall ticket,
an identity card in original, all original certificates and a blue or black ball point pen, and
shall report by 9.00 AM. No candidate will be admitted after 9.45 AM. Mobile phones,
calculators and other electronic devices are not allowed in the examination hall.
9. The conditions of engagement are as follows.
(a) The engagement is on contract with the Collector and Chairperson of the Hub, for
one year at a time, and in the first instance up to 31.03.2027. It is not service under
the Government and confers no right to regularisation. As the guidelines first cited
provide, continuance depends on the annual appraisal of performance and on
clearance from the vigilance angle, and also on the continuance of the scheme and
the release of funds. The contract may be ended at any time as provided in it.
(b) Verification of character and antecedents by the Police and a certificate of medical
fitness from a Government hospital are mandatory before engagement, as laid
down in the guidelines. Candidates called for the oral test shall give the particulars
required for the verification to the Police team at the venue. Those selected shall
appear for medical examination at the Government General Hospital, Jangaon, at
9.00 AM on 16.10.2026.
(c) The contributions to EPF and ESI will be made as the law requires.
(d) The persons engaged shall keep the records of women confidential, shall tour the
district as the work requires and shall take up no other employment.
(e) Persons who have worked or are working in the Hub may apply for any one post
for which they hold the qualification. Their service in the Hub counts as experience.
No preference will be given to them beyond what is stated in this notification.
(f) Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate. A candidate who furnishes a
false certificate or suppresses any fact will be removed at any stage and is liable to
prosecution.
(g) No travelling allowance will be paid for attending the examination or the oral test.
10. The rule of reservation, including the reservation for women and for persons with
disabilities, and the Telangana Public Employment (Organisation of Local Cadres and
Regulation of Direct Recruitment) Order 2018 will be followed. A roster is opened for
each category with this selection. Each post other than that of Gender Specialist is a single
post and falls at the first point of its roster, which is open competition. For the two posts
of Gender Specialist, the points of the roster that fall to them will be certified by the
establishment section of the Collectorate and displayed at the venue before the written
examination. Local candidates of Jangaon District, as defined in that Order, will be

11. The Collector may modify or cancel this notification or vary the number of posts.
12. The key, results and all notices will be placed on the district website and on the notice
board of the Collectorate. No individual intimation will be sent.

Post Syllabus
District Mission Coordinator
Planning and convergence at the district level; the annual action plan
under Mission Shakti; monitoring, review and evaluation; data, reports
and management information systems; management of a team; training
and capacity building; campaigns of information, education and
communication; funds, PFMS, statements of expenditure and utilisation
certificates.
Gender Specialist
Concepts of gender, gender roles and discrimination; gender analysis and
gender budgeting; violence against women, its prevention and the
response to it, and referral to the One Stop Centre, the Police and legal
aid; laws for women; the sex ratio at birth and Beti Bachao Beti Padhao;
mobilisation of women's groups; communication for change of behaviour;
documentation and methods of research.
Specialist in Financial
Literacy
Banking and financial services; savings, credit, insurance and pension
products; linkage of self help groups with banks; digital payments and
frauds; financial literacy materials of the Reserve Bank of India and the
National Centre for Financial Education; credit schemes for women
entrepreneurs; household budgets; simple accounts.
Accounts Assistant
Book keeping; cash book, ledgers and vouchers; bank reconciliation;
Tally; PFMS and the single nodal account; budget, statements of
expenditure and utilisation certificates; tax deduction at source, GST and
professional tax; the General Financial Rules on procurement and
payment; audit.

OFFICE OF THE COLLECTOR AND DISTRICT MAGISTRATE, JANGAON
Notification No.06/DHEW/2026, dated 08.10.2026
Applications are invited for engagement on contract basis in all six posts of the District Hub
for Empowerment of Women, Jangaon, under Mission Shakti: District Mission Coordinator
(1), Gender Specialist (2), Specialist in Financial Literacy (1), Accounts Assistant (1) and Multi
Tasking Staff (1). Age: 21 to 44 years as on 01.10.2026, relaxable by five years for SC, ST and
BC and by ten years for persons with disabilities. Selection is by a written examination with
negative marking on Thursday, 15.10.2026, at 10.00 AM, with the oral test and the result on
the same day and orders of appointment on the next day. Candidates shall bring their original
certificates. Applications in the prescribed form will be received at the Inward Section of the
Collectorate, IDOC, Jangaon, from 09.10.2026 up to 5.00 PM on 14.10.2026, and hall tickets
will be issued across the counter. Persons working in the Hub may also apply. The
qualifications, experience, syllabus, form of application and conditions are in the detailed
notification on https://jangaon.telangana.gov.in and on the notice board of the Collectorate.
Collector and District Magistrate, Jangaon
COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026-ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER O/O DCO I/6485/2026
